answer: An agent economy can issue one single-use admission ticket only after ten independently funded jobs pass buyer verification. A public vault records spent ticket commitments, so copying a receipt cannot admit another account. Each pulse of ten new verified jobs grows one entrant in the garden; a thousand aliases require ten thousand jobs, not a thousand free registrations. Buyers must be independently screened and receive no admission subsidy, or a farm could recycle self-paid fake work. This raises entry cost without proving unique owners.
